text:
sarah: FYI — incoming ticket from Acme (acct 54321). Invoice INV-2026-1123 was issued without their PO and AP won't process it. They provided PO 987654 and need the invoice reissued so payment can go through. Payment attempt status: unpaid. Can billing run reissue + credit/rebill? link: https://uploads.example.com/screenshot.png

tyler: Can you paste the payment id and confirm invoice amount? also is tax/VAT expected to change with PO?

sarah: Account 54321, invoice total $2,375.24 USD. Payment attempt id pay_98321 (no capture). Customer says AP requires PO on invoice before they release payment — no VAT change, US-based buyer.

kevin: Ok. Recommended path for unpaid invoice: void/origin credit memo + reissue new invoice with PO appended. Steps I suggest: 1) create credit memo for INV-2026-1123 (reason: missing_po) 2) create new invoice INV-2026-1123-R1 identical lines + "po_number": "987654" 3) mark original invoice as replaced 4) if there is a held payment, attach to new invoice or instruct customer to re-initiate.

kevin: Quick API snippets (internal tooling):
```bash
# credit memo
curl -X POST "https://internal-billing.redwood/v1/credit_memos" -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-1123","reason":"missing_po","note":"reissue with PO 987654"}'

# create reissued invoice
curl -X POST "https://internal-billing.redwood/v1/invoices" -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"account_id":"54321","reference":"INV-2026-1123-R1","po_number":"987654","lines":[{"desc":"Usage Jan 2026","amount":2375.24}],"due_date":"2026-03-15"}'

# attach held payment (if capture available)
curl -X POST "https://internal-payments.redwood/v1/attachments" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PAY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"payment_id":"pay_98321","invoice_id":"INV-2026-1123-R1"}'
```

marta: tagging finance ops — since amount <$5k we can do manual reissue without exec approval. Please include a note for audit: "reissued for PO 987654 per customer request; original invoice voided." Also add ledger tag `reason: missing_po`.

billing-bot: auto-void-scan found invoice INV-2026-1123 in status: issued -> pending_reissue. Flagging: urgent.

tyler: Couple reminders: - preserve original invoice date in internal notes for AP reconciliation - update customer-facing invoice PDF to show PO number in header (some customers require exact location) - confirm Emailed copy to accounts.payable@acme.com after reissue.

sarah: I will execute the steps. Will create credit memo and new invoice now and ping when done. @kevin @marta cc: finance@redwood.com :white_check_mark:

kevin: After you create the new invoice, hit the internal job `rebill-apply` to reconcile pending payments. If attachment fails, we can manually mark payment as "ready_to_capture" and re-run capture.

marta: Once done please add a short reconciliation note in the invoice record: "original INV-2026-1123 voided; reissued INV-2026-1123-R1 with PO 987654; customer confirmed AP will release payment after reissue."

sarah: Done — credit memo CM-2026-449 created, new invoice INV-2026-1123-R1 created with PO 987654 and PDF updated. Ran rebill-apply. Payment pay_98321 now attached and showing status: pending_capture. Email to accounts.payable@acme.com sent with new PDF.

kevin: Verified in ledger — original invoice marked replaced, credit memo posted. Payment shows pending_capture; finance to monitor. Great work.

marta: Closing loop: finance will watch capture and confirm allocation. If capture fails, we'll coordinate refund/resubmit. Closing ticket after payment completes. :lock:
